list.title: What Are Containers? Understanding the Role of Containers, VMs, and Bare Metal in Modern Software Deployment
list.subheading: Demystifying Containers: A Comprehensive Guide to Understanding Why Containers Have Revolutionized Software Deployment
list.excerpt: Confused about containers, VMs, and bare metal? This blog post explains what containers are, why they are essential in modern software deployment, and how they compare to Virtual Machines and bare-metal systems. We'll also dig into Docker and the Open Container Initiative (OCI) to give you a well-rounded understanding.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Jobee - Job Search App
list.subheading: RESTful API and Platform for Job Seekers and Employers
list.excerpt: Comprehensive job search platform, implemented as a RESTful API. It's built using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. The API supports a wide array of features, including advanced search filters, authentication, and file uploads, among others.
